hooks.command: cd ~/george-os 2>/dev/null || exit 0; echo '== From the george-os brain (read before anything else) =='; [ -f BRAIN.md ] && { echo '--- BRAIN.md ---'; head -n 150 BRAIN.md; }; [ -f NOW.md ] && { echo '--- NOW.md ---'; head -n 60 NOW.md; }; h=$(ls -t handoffs/*.md 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); [ -n "$h" ] && { echo "--- newest handoff: $h ---"; head -n 60 "$h"; }; exit 0

in=$(cat); printf '%s' "$in" | grep -q '"stop_hook_active": *true' && exit 0; [ -d ~/george-os/.git ] || exit 0; dirty=$(git -C ~/george-os status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); ahead=$(git -C ~/george-os rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 0); [ -z "$dirty" ] && [ "$ahead" = "0" ] && exit 0; echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "Reminder: the george-os brain has changes that are not saved or not pushed yet. Run george-handoff now (WORKLOG line, handoff file, NOW.md, pull, rebase and push to main), tell George the commit, then stop."}'; exit 0
